vendor_treatment: Yahoo Close is split-adjusted; Adj Close also adjusts dividends via multiplicative factors (CRSP convention). Working convention: split-normalized Volume; snapshot audit is heuristic, with BEP ratios closer to nominal-share behavior. No issuer tape establishes a universal volume adjustment rule.
original_level_features: Historically rescaled price levels; later events can change past levels. One constant applied to all windows and training stats cancels in z-scores, sample-dependent rebasing need not.
causal_window_relative_features: OHLC log(P/anchor Close) removes a constant price factor within the entire window; it does not erase a factor step inside a window. Centered log1p Volume retains within-window denomination changes; +1 prevents exact scale invariance near zero.
labels: A constant price multiplier cancels in log(P[t+h]/P[t]); correct split adjustment avoids denomination-only jumps. Incorrect/missing factors or vendor revisions across endpoints can change labels.
portfolio_returns_covariances: Per-security constant scaling cancels in returns, ratio signals and return covariance; adjustment steps and wrong identity can change inputs.

vendor_treatment: Same split-adjusted Close / dividend-adjusted Adj Close convention. Working convention: split-normalized Volume; snapshot audit is heuristic, with BEP ratios closer to nominal-share behavior. No issuer tape establishes a universal volume adjustment rule.
original_level_features: Repeated reverse splits inflate historical reported price levels relative to current shares; original level z-scores can place early data far from TRAIN means.
causal_window_relative_features: Constant price scale cancels within each window; zero/very low Volume and within-window denomination changes remain visible after log1p centering.
labels: Pure share denomination changes should not produce a mechanical return after correct adjustment; economic post-event price moves remain.
portfolio_returns_covariances: Split-adjusted returns cancel denomination factors; event-associated actual returns and volume/identity defects are not removed.

vendor_treatment: Close excludes dividend adjustment; Adj Close includes dividend multipliers. OHLC in original auto_adjust=True snapshot follows dividend adjustment; Volume is not cash-dividend-adjusted.
original_level_features: Future dividends can rebase historical adjusted levels; windows spanning an ex-date can contain nonconstant factors. Snapshot CWEN June1 and NEE June5 factor steps were already observed.
causal_window_relative_features: Constant dividend rebasing outside a window cancels; factors varying inside the window still affect relative paths. Causal construction alone does not certify correct cash data.
labels: Adjusted-close log returns are a vendor gross total-return proxy; nominal Close-only returns include ex-dividend drops. Cash rounding, fees and taxes are separate from gross amounts.
portfolio_returns_covariances: Gross adjusted-close returns carry vendor dividend factors; ratio invariance holds for fixed anchor rebasing, not arbitrary changes of the dividend series.

vendor_treatment: Can be encoded in a vendor split field rather than as a typed distribution. BEP July30 vendor1.251 conflicts with issuer1 BEPC per4 BEP; factor and volume treatment require event-specific verification.
original_level_features: May rebase past levels and change security count/value interpretation. A generic split tag cannot establish the legal entitlement or economically correct adjustment.
causal_window_relative_features: Cancels only a uniform price multiplier; retains event-spanning relative movements and cannot reconstruct missing distributed-security value or identity.
labels: Need correct cash/noncash entitlement and valuation. Vendor adjusted-price labels may embed an opaque factor; this audit does not replace or authenticate it.
portfolio_returns_covariances: Vendor total-return proxy may differ from the return on an actual portfolio holding both retained and distributed securities; no price-ratio test proves the distribution factor correct.

vendor_treatment: Ticker history may be continuous across a rename or may belong to a different class. Corporate-action price fields alone do not provide authenticated security mapping.
original_level_features: Different class histories can change price levels, volume and historical coverage; a name change alone need not change economics.
causal_window_relative_features: Scale invariance does not identify securities, distinguish voting classes, or repair stitched histories.
labels: A true same-security rename can preserve labels; a class conversion, ADS ratio change or mistaken link can change interpretation and coverage.
portfolio_returns_covariances: Requires contemporaneous class/identifier eligibility, conversions and distributed holdings; stable ratios do not validate a ticker mapping.
